kernel_scope: The shadow numerator stays odd and in the dyadic bounds for every index.
No shadow state after time zero has an odd denominator.
written_scope: Real Collatz-series sum is -2 with error at most 2*(13/15)^J.
The symbolic word is not eventually periodic and has lower one-density at least log(2)/log(13/5).
The 2-adic sum is odd, distinct from the rational real sum.
The periodic word 01^infinity has the same real sum -2 but a different 2-adic sum, so the real sum does not determine compatible residues.
finite_scope: 2000 exact recurrence steps; independent Fraction replay through 128 steps; parity reconstruction at lengths 64, 128, 512, 2000.

locations: Section 6, rational real sums and the proof of Theorem 1
source_audit.conclusion: Counterexample to identification of real and 2-adic limits and the intermediate real-irrationality inference; not a disproof of Theorem 1 itself.

conjecture_status: Unresolved; this is a symbolic pseudo-trajectory, not a positive-integer counterexample.
